title: Le plateau touche le dossier
anim_prompt:
Painterly animated scene on a Parisian café terrace at golden hour, thick visible gouache and oil brushstrokes. The camera stays completely still. One continuous take with no cuts.

First second: the seated man in the rust-red jacket on the left puts both hands flat on the edge of his own round table and pushes against it to settle back, so that his own wicker chair slides backward about fifteen centimeters into the narrow passage, with a short scrape on the stone floor. He does it himself, casually, without looking behind him.

Then: the waiter, who carries his round tray firmly with BOTH hands under it the whole time, keeps walking forward along the passage at the same pace. His hands never leave the tray and never touch the chair or the man. Because the chair is now in his way, the low edge of the tray bumps into the top of the chair back. The white cup on the tray wobbles and starts to tip. The clip ends right there, before any coffee falls.

The woman in the green cardigan on the right and the old man with glasses at the back table stay seated and calm.
